About

I am a Ph.D. candidate in Computer Science at The George Washington University. I received my M.S. in Computer Science from UC Davis and my B.S. in Mathematics from the Hua Loo-Keng Honors Class at Beihang University. My research lies at the intersection of mathematics and computer sciences, with a focus on optimal transport theory, neural network optimization, machine learning, and hashing methods.
